cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Of course your brother can stay for dinner. I'll give him my pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Please don't worry. There are peas, and I had a substantial breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll order you a pizza. It takes forty minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How thoughtful. I'll keep everyone company while they eat, then you can all watch me have dinner at nine.

mechanism: A copies a misunderstood courteous practice, accommodates B graciously, and makes the personal cost increasingly visible.
confusable: Unlike angry helpfulness, D45 stays gracious; S04 must supply a mistaken model rather than generic politeness.
comparison: Host giving up dinner versus carrying a heavy bag on a changed route.
seedUse: Preserve B helpful pizza offer and bag-sharing offer as causes, not hostile obstructions.
